scientific_limitations: The formula assumes a common-rate iid exponential parent and the uncorrected finite-sample Gini coefficient. No distribution-free extension, claim about correlation maximization, or independent verification is made. Potential older joint Lorenz-process or reliability-transform statements remain an originality risk; the full 1978 papers and the full 2010 top-shares manuscript were not accessible through the available lawful routes.
title: A sharp upper-share covariance profile for the exponential sample Gini index
